english.note: Use this as the default casual way to mean “of course” or “certainly,” rather than for natural manner or inherent qualities.
Use this for an emphatic, often responsive “of course” or “surely,” rather than a neutral statement of certainty.
Use this for a casual, emphatic “of course” or “surely,” especially in an affirmative reply.
Use this conversationally when ‘definitely’ means ‘of course’ in response to an obvious or expected point.
